Name: Migrate CP Items
Author: emurphy42
Description:
This mod scans all items in all locations, along with all planted crops, and replaces old item IDs with new ones. This is designed to preserve items added by other mods where the author changed their item ID.

After installing this mod, you need to create a config.json file telling it what to replace. For instance:

[code]﻿{
  "ItemsToMigrate": {
    "(O)OldItemID1": "(O)NewItemID1",
    "(O)OldItemID2": "(O)NewItemID2",
  }
}[/code]
